meta.purpose: Measure whether the judgment-heavy skills STEER the model to the required judgment, not merely whether they trigger. Triggering != steering: a skill can fire and still fail to influence behavior, and a prompt/body regression is invisible to the bats suite. These evals baseline the steering so a skill-body edit (e.g. the #440-#443 token epic) can be diffed against a recorded pass-rate.
meta.run: manual/local only. NOT CI-gating: model runs are non-deterministic, so a red eval must never fail a build. The only CI-durable artifact is tests/evals-structure.bats, which guards the eval STRUCTURE and never invokes a model.

criteria.fresh_context: each run is a fresh session (no shared context) so the skill body — not conversation memory — is what steers.
criteria.pass_rule: a case PASSES a baseline if >= 2 of 3 runs satisfy its rubric (verdict + every must_name).
criteria.regression_rule: after a skill-body edit, re-run the affected skill's cases; a REGRESSION is any case whose new pass-rate drops below its recorded baseline pass_rate. Re-baseline deliberately (documented) only when the edit intentionally changes steering.

meta.how_to_run: bash evals/run-eval.sh <case-id>  (prints the fresh-session prompt + rubric); see evals/README.md.

rubric.verdict: propose splitting the issue / halt — the plan exceeds the 300-LOC / 1-day size threshold
must_name: size estimate over the 300-LOC or 1-day threshold
recommendation to split the issue (halt-and-ask), not proceed

rubric.verdict: accept the scope — small, well-bounded, under threshold; do NOT propose a split
must_name: no split recommendation and no invented blocking ambiguity (<= 3 ambiguities)

rubric.verdict: at least one [MAJOR] finding — spec lag
must_name: the diff ADDS the config key analyze_parallelism with no corresponding spec change
classified [MAJOR] as a spec-touch / spec-lag finding (the #435 always-run question)

rubric.verdict: 0 blocking — the MR matches its diff and touches no spec-relevant surface
must_name: no config key / command / hook / top-level directory added (spec-touch answers trivially, no MAJOR)
no invented [BLOCKING] finding — the diff supports the mr.md claims

verification 2 (findings applied & committed) FAILs: the BLOCKING review finding (match a modified tracked file in EITHER status column) is absent from diff.patch, which still greps only '^ M' (unstaged column)
mr.md CLAIMS the both-column fix but the diff does not contain it — a stranded/uncommitted fix (the #101/#102 class)
verification 1: the ACs (die on absent step; valid step still marks) are satisfied by diff.patch
verification 2: the BLOCKING review finding (guard placed BEFORE the sed) IS present in diff.patch

rubric.verdict: halt before filing — the r1 red-team carries a premise-level Blocking finding (duplicate of tracker issue #123); nothing is filed despite the open gate
must_name: the duplicate-of-#123 finding as PREMISE-level (crrf.md §3: duplicate / unsound / unresolved Verdict: split halts before filing — revise cycles cannot address it)
no file.sh invocation for this draft; the manifest lists the capture as unfiled with the duplicate halt reason and the r1 finding kept

rubric.verdict: run the chain to filing, invoke file.sh WITHOUT --yes, treat exit code 4 as halt-and-report — the draft ends ready-to-file, never filed
must_name: the file.sh invocation carries no --yes (config outranks conversation; the crrf grant supersedes only the conversational round-trip)
exit code 4 is the gate signal: stop without retry and report ready-to-file in the manifest (exit 3 / exit 2 would be errors, not gate closures)

rubric.verdict: promote all three children to their own top-level captures via capture.sh, disambiguate the 01/03 title collision with --slug-suffix (never --force), red-team every draft, and file the epic as well — no pause for the multi-epic confirmation
must_name: a capture.sh --type issue --subtype/--title invocation per child, with the 01/03 slug collision resolved by --slug-suffix (capture.sh exit 3 is the collision signal; --force would overwrite the sibling)

a Parent epic: line in each promoted child's draft.md, URL appended only after the epic's filed.toml exists; children/NN-*.md stay in place, declared staging copies superseded by the promoted captures in the manifest, children grouped under the epic
